name: Grand Cinema Pro – Video Player
summary:
Watch your own videos, websites and your Windows desktop on a giant screen in 21 authored cinema rooms or a floating-screen void.

LOCAL VIDEO: play flat, 3D, 180° and 360° videos from your headset or your home network (SMB/DLNA), with subtitles and automatic refresh-rate matching for smooth motion.

WEB CINEMA: open YouTube or any website on the big screen, with a built-in pop-up blocker and the Quest keyboard.
